components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action used to advance brand setup and analysis.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:3.65rem; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.5rem; border:0; border-radius:.25rem; background:var(--aubergine); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; padding:.95rem 1.15rem; font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; font-weight:700; transition:background-color 180ms ease-out,box-shadow 180ms ease-out,transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:1.25rem; height:1.25rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--aubergine-deep); box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgb(23 21 29 / .2); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--signal); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:.66; }

components.name: Dark Text Field
components.description: An inverse field for forms placed on the Carbon narrative plane.
components.css: .ds-field-dark { display:block; color:var(--mineral); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-field-dark > span { display:block; margin-bottom:.55rem; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field-dark input { width:100%; border:1px solid rgb(242 243 236 / .48); border-radius:.25rem; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .025); color:var(--mineral); caret-color:var(--signal); min-height:3.2rem; padding:.75rem 1rem; font:inherit; transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field-dark input::placeholder { color:rgb(242 243 236 / .57); } .ds-field-dark input:hover,.ds-field-dark input:focus { border-color:var(--signal); background:rgb(255 255 255 / .055); outline:none; }

components.name: Light Text Field
components.description: The dossier-surface field for workspace name and company website.
components.css: .ds-field-light { display:block; color:var(--carbon); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-field-light > span { display:block; margin-bottom:.55rem; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field-light input { width:100%; border:1px solid rgb(23 21 29 / .28); border-radius:.25rem; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .38); color:var(--carbon); caret-color:var(--signal); min-height:3.2rem; padding:.75rem 1rem; font:inherit; transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field-light input::placeholder { color:#666763; } .ds-field-light input:hover,.ds-field-light input:focus { border-color:var(--signal); background:#fff; outline:none; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: The lowercase condensed wordmark with its Acid Signal stop.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; color:var(--carbon); } .ds-brand-mark span { font-family:var(--font-display),sans-serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-brand-mark i { width:.625rem; height:.625rem; background:var(--signal); }

components.name: Indexed Progress Rail
components.description: The four-step orientation rail that keeps the onboarding journey legible.
components.css: .ds-progress { width:106px; background:var(--carbon); color:var(--mineral); border-right:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .18); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-progress ol { display:grid; grid-template-rows:repeat(4,1fr); min-height:480px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; } .ds-progress li { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:.75rem 1.25rem; border-bottom:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .18); color:rgb(242 243 236 / .48); } .ds-progress li.ds-complete { color:var(--mineral); } .ds-progress li.ds-active { color:var(--signal); } .ds-progress b { font-family:var(--font-display),sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-progress span { margin-top:.25rem; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-progress i { position:absolute; top:50%; right:-1px; width:.875rem; height:2.25rem; transform:translateY(-50%); background:var(--signal); clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 50%,0 100%); }

components.name: Clipped Dossier Tabs
components.description: Overlapping file-index tabs that echo the current onboarding step above the paper plane.
components.html: 01 Access02 Workspace03 Profile04 Dashboard
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; height:4rem; overflow:hidden; border-bottom:1px solid rgb(23 21 29 / .16); background:rgb(216 220 207 / .55); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-tabs span { display:flex; min-width:9rem; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; margin-right:-.5rem; padding:0 1.25rem; border-right:1px solid rgb(23 21 29 / .2); background:rgb(216 220 207 / .55); color:rgb(23 21 29 / .52); clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 14px) 0,100% 100%,0 100%); font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-tabs span.ds-tab-active { background:var(--paper); color:var(--carbon); } .ds-tabs span b { font:inherit; } .ds-tabs span.ds-tab-active b { color:var(--aubergine); }

components.name: Evidence Mark
components.description: A compact confirmation used only after a signal has been captured or resolved.
components.html: Position found
components.css: .ds-evidence-mark { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; color:var(--carbon); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-evidence-mark > span { display:flex; width:2rem; height:2rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--signal); color:var(--carbon); } .ds-evidence-mark svg { width:1rem; height:1rem; }

components.name: Dashboard Navigation Item
components.description: An indexed Carbon-sidebar destination with a flat Acid Signal active state.
components.css: .ds-dashboard-nav { display:grid; gap:.25rem; width:220px; padding:1rem; background:var(--carbon); font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-dashboard-nav button { display:flex; width:100%; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border:0; padding:.75rem; background:transparent; color:rgb(242 243 236 / .46); font:inherit; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; text-align:left; } .ds-dashboard-nav button.ds-nav-active { background:var(--signal); color:var(--carbon); } .ds-dashboard-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--signal); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-dashboard-nav span { font-family:var(--font-display),sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.035em; }

components.name: Paper Evidence Tile
components.description: A square factual tile used inside a hairline evidence grid.
components.css: .ds-evidence-tile { width:220px; border:1px solid rgb(23 21 29 / .18); background:var(--paper); color:var(--carbon); padding:1.25rem; font-family:var(--font-body),sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-tile span { color:var(--aubergine); font-family:var(--font-display),sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-evidence-tile p { margin:.5rem 0 0; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:700; }

narrative.overview:
Signal Dossier treats brand onboarding and campaign intelligence as an editorial evidence file: measured, indexed, and useful before it is decorative. Carbon framing holds a mineral-and-paper working surface, while fine rules, ordered numerals, and clipped tabs make progress and provenance legible.

The atmosphere is forensic but not cold. Aubergine carries deliberate actions, acid-lime marks verified evidence and current state, and the condensed display face gives the dossier a strong editorial voice without sacrificing Manrope's operational clarity. The system rejects generic centered SaaS wizard styling, the former naano-blue reflex, and orange accenting.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial evidence surfaces with a subtle paper grain.
Carbon framing, mineral working planes, aubergine controls, and sparse acid-lime state marks.
Indexed progress, clipped file tabs, precise hairlines, and zero ornamental card chrome.
Condensed, high-impact headings paired with calm, readable body copy.

rules.name: The Signal Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Acid-lime marks verified, active, selected, or keyboard-focused information; it is never a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The No Blue, No Orange Rule
rules.body: Keep the shipped carbon, mineral, aubergine, and acid-lime identity; do not revive a naano-blue palette or introduce orange.

rules.name: The Condensed Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for declarative headings, ordered indexes, and the wordmark; keep operating copy and controls in Manrope.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Large display text is bold and tightly tracked (`-0.035em`) with compact line-height; do not loosen it into generic marketing type.

rules.name: The Indexed Journey Rule
rules.body: Multi-step brand setup keeps the numbered progress system visible; spatial orientation is part of the trust model.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep information surfaces flat at rest; use hairlines, tone, and paper texture to organize evidence.

rules.name: The Cut-Paper Rule
rules.body: Use clipped geometry only for index and progress wayfinding; do not spread novelty silhouettes across ordinary content.

dos: Do build information hierarchy with indexed numerals, hairlines, tonal planes, and evidence labels.
Do reserve Acid Signal for verified evidence, current state, selection, and keyboard focus.
Do pair bold condensed declarations with readable Manrope explanations and controls.
Do preserve the carbon frame and paper evidence relationship when extending brand workflows.
donts: Don't turn the product into a centered, rounded-card SaaS wizard.
Don't use Acid Signal as a large decorative background or as routine body text.
Don't introduce blue or orange accents into the shipped palette.
Don't add ambient card shadows, pill-shaped controls, or decorative clipping to ordinary content.
